map.MSI 条形码。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: MSI Barcode is an online tool built for developers. It runs entirely in your browser — your code never leaves it.
map.每位数字 = 8 个单元（0→窄空宽条，1→宽条窄空，其余按二进制展开）: Each digit = 8 elements (0 → narrow space, wide bar; 1 → wide bar, narrow space; the rest expand in binary)
map.MSI（Modified Plessey）是脉冲调制型条码，每位数字用 8 个单: MSI (Modified Plessey) is a pulse-width modulated barcode in which each digit uses 8 elements: 0 is encoded as narrow space + wide bar, 1 as wide bar + narrow space, and the remaining digits expand into 8 alternating wide/narrow elements according to their binary bits. It contains digits only, has medium density, and is mainly used for retail shelf labels and warehouse bin markers. MSI itself has no check digit, so in practice a Mod 10 (the Luhn algorithm), Mod 11, or double Mod 1010 check digit is appended to guard against misreads.
map.货架与库位标签：MSI 常见于零售货架价签与仓库库位标识，只有数字、可用点阵或热: Shelf and bin labels: MSI is common on retail shelf price tags and warehouse bin markers. Digits only, it can be printed on dot-matrix or thermal printers at low cost and is easy to read.
map.追加校验位：MSI 本身无校验，实际使用常追加 Mod 10（Luhn）、Mod: Appended check digits: MSI has no built-in check. In practice a Mod 10 (Luhn), Mod 11, or two-round Mod 1010 check is appended; before integrating with a legacy system, confirm which one it uses, or the scan will come back 1–2 digits longer.
map.输入数字串（如 `123456789`）→ 渲染 MSI 条码图形；请按规范长度: Enter a numeric string (e.g. `123456789`) → renders an MSI barcode image; follow the prescribed length and check-digit rules.
map.MSI 默认有校验位吗？: Does MSI have a check digit by default?
map.没有。MSI 是脉冲调制型码，任一位被误读都会产生另一个合法字符，因此必须靠应用: No. MSI is a pulse-width modulated code, so misreading any one bit yields another valid character — an application-level check digit is therefore essential. Among the options, Mod 10 (Luhn) is the most common, Mod 11 adds one more check digit and a higher detection rate, and Mod 1010 runs two consecutive rounds of Mod 10.
map.不能。MSI 只定义了 0–9 十个数字，任何字母或符号都无法编码。若标签需要含: No. MSI defines only the ten digits 0–9; no letter or symbol can be encoded. If a label must contain letters (such as bin code A-01-03), use Code 39 or Code 128 instead.
